blurb: Banana River Park is situated on the intercoastal river and offers a waterfront soccer field, pavilion, playground, fishing platform, kayak dock, and other recreational amenities. The pavilion can be rented for private events. The park operates from 7:00 a.m. to dusk.
extraNote: Refundable deposit: $150 · Rental period 7:00 am - 10:00 pm including set-up/clean-up time · Alcohol prohibited without permit
